text: One question about a real repo. If I change this file, what breaks?
Sightread parses the imports first, so Kimi on Cerebras answers from evidence, not memory.
A hundred files sit downstream. The graph lists every one, with the line that imports it.
Then it asks Kimi again, with no graph, as a baseline.
Without the graph, Kimi named thirteen of the hundred, and took nearly ten seconds.
With it, one point two seconds. Eight times faster, with the full list on screen.
